customManagers.description: Next/common dependency versions purrfold pins into generated apps. Single source of truth: src/versions.json.

GitHub Action tags purrfold pins into generated .github/workflows/. Without this manager the generated pipelines rot silently: every app scaffolded before an action's major bump keeps running a deprecated runner (the actions/checkout@v4 node20 deprecation is exactly how this was found).
Fallback pnpm version written into a generated app's `packageManager` field when the running pnpm cannot be probed. Must stay an exact x.y.z: `packageManager` rejects ranges.

packageRules.description: Group non-major pin bumps into one weekly PR; the full E2E matrix in .github/workflows/e2e.yml validates it before merge.

Action tag bumps are grouped on their own: they change generated workflow YAML but no installed dependency, so they are reviewed against the template snapshots rather than the E2E matrix. Majors stay ungrouped — a runtime bump (node20 -> node24) deserves its own PR.
eslint stays on v9 until eslint-plugin-react ships v10 support (v10 removed context.getFilename(), still used transitively via eslint-config-next).
@vitejs/plugin-react v6 is a known-bad line for generated Next apps (original bug report: pulled vite@7 into the unit-test toolchain).
eslint-plugin-astro v2 peer-requires eslint >= 10, incompatible with the eslint v9 pin above. Unblock together with the eslint major (E2E caught this: npm ERESOLVE on Astro scenarios, PR #12).
Next/common generated apps require @vitejs/plugin-react below 5.2; Astro has its own override and may update independently.

prBodyNotes: This PR changes what purrfold installs into **generated apps** (`src/versions.json`). Before merging: the full E2E matrix (`E2E` workflow) must be green, and this PR must add a changeset (`npm run changeset`) so the bump appears in the changelog. The `changeset-guard` check enforces that and will block the merge until the changeset is committed to this branch.
